About Us

Trusted by Organizers Who Can't Afford a Bad Event

Lafayette Sound is a full-service live event production company based in Lafayette, Indiana. With over 12 years of experience and more than 500 events delivered, we provide broadcast-quality audio, video, lighting, staging, and live streaming for corporate conferences, town halls, keynotes, and high-profile gatherings — for groups of 20 or 2,000.

Everything Your Event Needs

Presentations

Projectors, displays, slide management, and full run-of-show coordination.

Our Commitment

The "Zero-Fail" Guarantee

Every production is built with redundancy at every layer — backup audio paths, failover streaming encoders, duplicate wireless frequencies, and standby equipment staged on-site. Your audience never knows when something goes wrong behind the scenes. That's not luck — it's preparation.
